prefetch.verify:
import os, pathlib, sys
root = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('PADDLE_PDX_CACHE_HOME') or (pathlib.Path.home() / '.paddlex'))
names = [p.name for p in (root / 'official_models').iterdir()] if (root / 'official_models').is_dir() else []
sys.exit(0 if any('det' in n for n in names) and any('rec' in n for n in names) else 1)
